params.body:
## Why

Dealers embed their stock on their own site as an iframe. Cross-origin, the iframe cannot set its own height, so the dealer team handed web builders a copy-pasted `postMessage` listener ("zo dirty dat we dat script moeten meegeven"). Decision: one hosted script, one line to paste.

## What

**`public/embed/v1.js`** (static, ES5, no dependencies, ~110 lines). The dealer pastes:

```html
<script src="https://traders.stocklistdealer.eu/embed/v1.js" data-dealer="<hash>" data-lang="nl" async></script>
```

- Finds its own `<script>` (`document.currentScript`, fallback by `src`), creates an `<iframe>` right after it (`width 100%`, `border 0`, `scrolling="no"`, `loading="lazy"`, `allowfullscreen`, `title` from `data-title` or "Voorraad"), src = `/website/<hash>[/<params>][?lang=xx]`.
- Accepted parameters, as the catalogue already reads them (`WebsiteController::setLanguage` / `convertUrlParams`): `data-lang` (nl/fr/en/de, as `?lang=`), `data-usage` (`used`|`new`, path segment), `data-params` (raw `key=value&...` path segment, passthrough to `getForWebsite`'s where-params). Nothing else exists on the route, so nothing else is supported.
- Listens to `message`, accepts only `event.origin === <origin the script was loaded from>` and `event.source === iframe.contentWindow`, so several embeds on one page each keep their own height. `documentHeight` sets the height (+16 px buffer, never below `data-min-height`, default 500).
- `scrollToTop`: scrolls the parent just enough to show the top of the frame, only when that top is above the viewport. Never `scrollIntoView`.
- Exposes only `window.StocklistEmbed` (`frames`, `resize(px?)`) for debugging.

**Embed pages**: `detail.blade.php` posts `scrollToTop` once on load (next to the existing `documentHeight`), `search.blade.php` posts it after a filter change. A legacy listener ignores the message. Built on #482 (height on every change); nothing duplicated.

**Settings > Website**: new block "Voorraad op je website" with the one line (real hash, language from the existing picker, mono field, Kopieer button in the `ui-` vocabulary), a note that the old iframe-plus-listener keeps working and that builders who want their own layout have the public API below; the bare iframe url moved under a `<details>` "Geavanceerd: enkel de iframe-url". No new translation keys (the tab is hardcoded Dutch like its neighbours).

**Docs**: `docs/website-embed.md` (attributes, what happens, version/cache, legacy, API); rule **R S2-5.18** in `12-s2-eigen-wagenpark-publiceren.md` (5.17 was taken by #482 during this branch's life), tests tagged.

## Cache / versioning

`public/` is the web root, so the file is served by nginx. Forge's caching.conf may cache `.js` long: the versioned filename is the cache-buster. Compatible improvements land in `v1.js`; a breaking change is a new `v2.js`, `v1.js` never changes behaviour.

## Tests

`WebsiteEmbedScriptTest` (file exists, origin check, `documentHeight`, `scrollToTop`, no `scrollIntoView`, ES5 only; settings tab shows the line with a hash that decrypts to the logged-in dealer; embed pages post `scrollToTop`). Ran with `SettingsWebsiteIframeLanguageTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`: 31 tests, 826 assertions, OK (1 pre-existing incomplete). `SmokeTest`: 260 tests OK.

## Manual check

Local app + a parent page on a second origin (127.0.0.1:8618) with the one line pointing at 127.0.0.1:8617: iframe grew from 500 to 2005 px on load (5014 px at 390 px wide after #482), the text under it moved down, no inner scrollbar; clicking a card while scrolled 1000 px past the frame top opened the detail, height 1458 px (= wrapper 1382 + 60 + 16) and the parent scrolled back so the frame top sat at +16 px. Settings tab at 1440 and 390 checked; the picker switches the copied line to `data-lang="fr"`.
params.title: Website embed: one hosted script instead of a pasted listener
